spells.name: Fireball
unmodelled: Flammable objects in the area start burning

spells.name: Shatter
unmodelled: A Construct has Disadvantage on the save
Unattended nonmagical objects in the area also take the damage

spells.name: Hold Person
unmodelled: Targets Humanoids only; the engine does not track creature type
The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success
Upcasting targets one additional creature per slot level above 2

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
unmodelled: The next attack roll against a hit target before the end of your next turn has Advantage
